operatorDecision.reportedCharger: SlimQ charger rated above 280 W with Razer three-prong converter
operatorDecision.reportedEquivalentUse: The exact laptop games and performs ordinary full-power workloads without practical difference from the OEM Razer adapter.

productionAdmission.implementation: The exact PID 02E0 production battery factory admits response 1211 only for the RZ09-0581 on its current 3.01 and 4.00 host baseline. All other adapter responses, models, identity checks, controller checks, and feature-specific gates remain unchanged.

limitations: The retained hardware evidence is read-only and does not independently compare an OEM Razer 330 W adapter on the same machine.

This classification does not by itself admit HyperBoost, cooling-pad writes, pad-less operation, or any other feature; those operations retain their own identity, state, readback, restoration, and evidence gates.
The captured stability window was idle and short; the production classification is an explicit operator-approved compatibility decision made with those limitations retained.
